title: The Cursed Flagship
premise: A mutineered pirate captain uses an enchanted skeleton compass to retrieve his cursed flagship from an armada of ghost buccaneers.
logline: After being betrayed and marooned by his own crew, a pirate captain must follow an enchanted skeleton compass through haunted seas to reclaim his cursed flagship before a ghost armada binds it forever to the realm of the dead.

visualTone.cameraLenses: Panavision C-Series Anamorphic, 40mm T2.8, 75mm Portrait Anamorphic
visualTone.lightingPhilosophy: Moonlit chiaroscuro with volumetric fog, practical lantern motivation, spectral rim-lighting

sets.name: Black Reef Exile Shore
sets.description: Jagged volcanic shoreline scattered with driftwood, wreck debris and black sand beneath towering sea cliffs
sets.atmosphere: Salt spray, rolling mist, crashing waves, cold ocean winds
sets.lighting: Silver moonlight mixed with warm torchlight, deep shadows between rocks

sets.name: Cavern of Tides
sets.description: Ancient flooded cavern lined with glowing runes, coral-encrusted stone arches and tidal pools
sets.atmosphere: Echoing water drips, damp air, drifting sea fog
sets.lighting: Bioluminescent cyan reflections and shafts of moonlight through ceiling cracks

sets.name: Phantom Sea Passage
sets.description: Open ocean corridor surrounded by spectral whirlpools and ghostly currents
sets.atmosphere: Dense fog banks, supernatural winds, distant phantom voices
sets.lighting: Cold blue moonlight illuminating mist and cresting waves

sets.name: Ghost Armada Expanse
sets.description: Massive fleet of translucent pirate vessels drifting across a cursed sea
sets.atmosphere: Ethereal mist, floating embers of ghostly energy, unnerving silence
sets.lighting: Pale spectral glow and stark moonlit highlights

sets.name: The Revenant Crown
sets.description: Ancient cursed flagship with weathered black hull, skeletal ornamentation and torn enchanted sails
sets.atmosphere: Whispering spirits, creaking timber, drifting fog
sets.lighting: Ghost-fire lanterns casting green-blue highlights across dark wood

props.handlingNote: Held in one hand and consulted during navigation

props.narrativeSignificance: Binds the flagship to the ghost armada

scenes.name: The Call of the Compass
scenes.description: Moonlit isolation, cold blue palette, wet volcanic textures, ominous atmosphere

shots.description: 42 years old, angular face, strong jawline, storm-gray eyes, shoulder-length black hair streaked with silver, scar across left cheek wearing long weathered naval coat, layered belts, high collar, brass buckles holding an ivory compass crafted from carved bone with glowing green needle on a jagged volcanic shoreline scattered with driftwood, wreck debris and black sand beneath towering sea cliffs
shots.action: Exiled Captain studies the Skeleton Compass whilst standing in the Black Reef Exile Shore and says 'You still know the way.' Camera tracks forward for five seconds as the compass needle slowly rotates toward the sea.

shots.description: 28 years old, oval face, emerald eyes, braided auburn hair, freckles across nose wearing flowing layered robes, fitted vest, rune-etched accessories raising a bronze lantern containing flickering blue spectral flame on a jagged volcanic shoreline scattered with driftwood, wreck debris and black sand beneath towering sea cliffs
shots.action: Sea Mystic lifts the Ghostfire Lantern and says 'The dead wake with the tide.' Camera cranes upward revealing spectral patterns appearing in the mist.

shots.description: Exiled Captain and Sea Mystic entering an ancient flooded cavern lined with glowing runes, coral-encrusted stone arches and tidal pools while the Skeleton Compass glows intensely
shots.action: Exiled Captain follows the compass into the Cavern of Tides and says 'Then we sail tonight.' Camera dollies beside the pair as runes illuminate.

shots.description: 42 years old, angular face, strong jawline, storm-gray eyes, shoulder-length black hair streaked with silver, scar across left cheek wearing long weathered naval coat, layered belts, high collar, brass buckles revealing a gold insignia medallion embossed with a crowned kraken inside an ancient flooded cavern lined with glowing runes
shots.action: Exiled Captain grips the Captain's Seal and says 'My ship will answer to me again.' Camera pushes into the medallion until it fills frame.

scenes.name: Across the Phantom Sea
scenes.description: Spectral adventure, teal-blue palette, rolling fog, supernatural tension

shots.description: 22 years old, youthful features, blue eyes, curly brown hair, sun-weathered complexion wearing lightweight explorer jacket, utility harness and travel boots carrying a bronze lantern containing flickering blue spectral flame through an open ocean corridor surrounded by spectral whirlpools and ghostly currents
shots.action: Young Navigator holds the Ghostfire Lantern above the bow and says 'A channel is opening!' Camera races overhead following the vessel through fog.

shots.description: Exiled Captain steering by the Skeleton Compass through an open ocean corridor surrounded by spectral whirlpools and ghostly currents
shots.action: Exiled Captain points ahead and says 'Trust the compass.' Camera tracks alongside as waves crash across the deck.

shots.description: 60 years old, gaunt face, pale eyes, long white hair, weather-beaten skin wearing ceremonial naval coat with skeletal insignia and flowing cloak standing upon the Ghost Armada Expanse
shots.action: Ghost Admiral emerges from spectral fog and says 'The living do not command these waters.' Camera rises dramatically toward his looming figure.

shots.description: 45 years old, broad face, shaved head, dark beard, broken nose wearing dark pirate jacket, utility belts, loose trousers and boots gripping a curved steel blade with notched spine and worn grip among the Ghost Armada Expanse
shots.action: Mutineer First Mate draws the Mutineer's Cutlass and says 'The flagship belongs to me now.' Camera pushes toward the threatening blade.

scenes.name: Reclaiming the Revenant Crown
scenes.description: Supernatural battle, green-blue ghostfire palette, weathered timber textures, triumphant atmosphere

shots.description: Exiled Captain confronting Mutineer First Mate wielding a curved steel blade with notched spine and worn grip aboard the ancient cursed flagship with weathered black hull, skeletal ornamentation and torn enchanted sails
shots.action: Exiled Captain advances as Mutineer First Mate attacks. Exiled Captain says 'Your betrayal ends here.' Camera circles the duel.

shots.description: Sea Mystic reaching toward a massive rune-covered chain emitting pale spectral energy aboard the ancient cursed flagship with weathered black hull and torn enchanted sails
shots.action: Sea Mystic channels magic and says 'Break the binding!' Camera sweeps across the deck as energy courses through the Soul Anchor Chain.

shots.description: Exiled Captain straining against a massive rune-covered chain emitting pale spectral energy aboard the ancient cursed flagship
shots.action: Exiled Captain pulls the Soul Anchor Chain free and says 'The ship is ours!' Camera pushes tightly into the chain as runes shatter.

shots.description: Exiled Captain raising a gold insignia medallion embossed with a crowned kraken upon the ancient cursed flagship with weathered black hull, skeletal ornamentation and torn enchanted sails
shots.action: Exiled Captain raises the Captain's Seal and says 'Revenant Crown, sail for freedom.' Camera cranes upward for five seconds as the flagship breaks away from the fading ghost armada.
